dedupe_keys.name: power plant and hydropower dam locations in myanmar as of 2025 mimu and cde myanmar hdx

description: These two Humanitarian Data Exchange datasets from the Myanmar Information Management Unit (MIMU), produced by CDE Myanmar, give approximate centre-point locations of more than 100 power plants and larger generation facilities and more than 30 dams, weirs or water intakes used for hydropower in Myanmar as of 2025. Locations were identified from the Ministry of Electric Power reference map, OpenStreetMap, the World Bank 2018 strategic environmental assessment of the hydropower sector for dams, local knowledge and high-resolution satellite imagery. Attributes include a facility code, a non-authoritative English name, a best-guess operational status from imagery, and for power plants the generation source and maximum capacity. Both are served as shapefile and GeoJSON from the MIMU GeoNode, dated September 2025. MIMU products are free with attribution but may not be used on online platforms without prior written agreement. Coverage is national. Caveats: the data are labelled non-authoritative, planned and unconfirmed sites were excluded, and capacities partly rest on visual guesses. Simulation uses are generation and dam locations for hazard exposure and grid studies in Myanmar. Related records: data-myanmar-public-hospitals-mimu is another MIMU dataset.
